topic: Donation tax credit: federal 14.5% on the first $200 of gifts per return (2025), 29% above $200; you may claim gifts made by you or your spouse/common-law partner, so pooling receipts on one return can pay more; non-refundable; carry forward up to 5 years

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): couple, each gave $200 to registered charities in 2025. Split: 2 × ($200 × 14.5%) = $58. Pooled on one return: $200 × 14.5% + $200 × 29% = $29 + $58 = $87. Difference $29. Federal only; provincial credits not included; the 33% rate on gifts above $200 for income in the top bracket not used; the claimant must owe enough tax (non-refundable).
